name: American History
description: American History word search puzzles use calm civic and period English — colony, constitution, amendment, census, canal, frontier and congress — for adults who want a reflective history theme without campaign brands or partisan slogans. Play free online in your browser. Easy grids warm you up; medium adds diagonals; hard allows reverse words; large print enlarges letters for comfortable reading. Word lists stay educational and respectful: everyday terms from civic life and the long American story, not trivia quizzes or licensed drama titles. No timer and no account. Related hubs include Presidents, Independence Day and U.S. States. New solvers can start with how to play; readers who prefer bigger type should open a large-print history puzzle first.
